Job Description

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in Equity Research . You have found the right team.

As an " Equity Research Professional” within our dynamic team, you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

• Track companies within the European Technology space.
• Build and maintain financial models to support investment valuation, leveraging advanced Excel and modeling skills.
• Develop financial forecasts under direction of the Senior Research Analyst and Portfolio Managers.
• Perform relative value comparisons across European Tech companies and peers.
• Support coverage initiation by assisting the Senior Research Analyst with analysis and investment materials.
• Generate timely macroeconomic, political, and company insights relevant to the sector and covered names.
• Identify new investment ideas and opportunities within the coverage universe.
• Evaluate existing investments through ongoing fundamental analysis, valuation work, and coverage maintenance.
• Manage interactions with company management teams and sell-side analysts as part of the research process.
• Collaborate and communicate with a global network of JPMorganChase Asset Management Technology analysts.
• Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, measured investment judgment, and proactive teamwork in day-to-day execution.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Hold a post graduate degree.
• Bring at least 3 years of relevant investment experience.
• Apply strong analytical skills and sound decision-making to investment research.
• Exhibit measured investment judgment, intellectual curiosity, and intellectual honesty.
• Communicate proactively and work effectively in a team environment.
• Operate in an EMEA shift schedule (1:30pm to 10:30pm).
• Sustain high motivation and a strong work ethic in a demanding research role.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

• Possess a CFA (preferred).
• Demonstrate prior Equity Research experience (preferred, ideally covering the Technology sector).

ABOUT US

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Architect in our ISV Practice, you will be the technical design lead for engagements with independent software vendors (ISVs). You will work with ISV development leaders, senior engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to design how MongoDB integrates with and extends the partner’s product.

This is an application architecture role, not a database administration or database consulting role. You will ensure that the designs implemented by the team are practical, production-ready, and reusable across future partner engagements.

Learn more about #LifeAtMongoDB here!

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do at MongoDB

  • Lead technical design for ISV engagements by understanding partner architecture and delivery models, then defining MongoDB data models, access patterns, indexing, and integration approaches for products serving different industries
  • Design MongoDB as a supported platform option alongside Oracle, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server, including persistence abstractions, feature parity, backend-specific behavior, and certification requirements
  • Design coexistence architectures and migration paths, including data flows, synchronization, consistency, application refactoring, dual-run strategies, validation, and controlled cutover
  • Lead design reviews, provide technical direction, and review schemas, queries, indexes, MongoDB-related code, and performance against realistic partner workloads
  • Design solutions across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or air-gapped on-premises environments
  • Build reusable architecture patterns, migration playbooks, code templates, decision frameworks, and other assets that make future partner engagements faster and more consistent
  • Stay hands-on by reading partner code and prototyping critical paths, act as the technical escalation point for Forward Deployed Engineers, and share recurring technical gaps and patterns with MongoDB Product and Engineering teams

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • 8+ years of experience in backend engineering and application architecture, delivering production software products
  • Strong application-side MongoDB expertise, including access-pattern-driven data modeling, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, replication, sharding, and sizing
  • Application-level experience with at least one major relational database and integrating a new database into a large production codebase, including persistence abstraction, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, transactional boundaries, and incremental rollout
  • Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
  • Strong SaaS and product-engineering knowledge, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed-cloud, Kubernetes-based private-cloud, or self-managed on-premises deployments
  • The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
  • Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

  • Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward-deployed, resident-architect, embedded-architect, or similar technical delivery role
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
  • Experience with regulated or data-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data-governance requirements
  • MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn

  • Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
  • Develop advanced experience in multi-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
  • Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Talent Partner, G&A

Location: Bengaluru, India — Hybrid Department: People — Talent Acquisition

 

About the Role

You'll lead hiring for Rubrik's G&A organization in India, and be the talent voice in the room when leaders decide how those teams get built. This is a senior individual-contributor seat: you'll run the hardest G&A searches yourself — Finance, Legal, People, IT, Business Operations — while advising VPs on leveling, location, and org shape, and setting the standard the wider Talent Partner team follows.

About the Team

Rubrik's India Talent Acquisition team hires across Engineering, Go-to-Market, and G&A from our Bengaluru site, one of the company's fastest-growing locations. You'll be among the most senior recruiters here, partnering with functional leaders and their global counterparts, and looked to by peers on how full life-cycle recruiting should be done.

What You'll Do

  • Lead full life-cycle recruitment for Rubrik's most complex and senior G&A searches in India — leadership hires and scarce specialist roles alike.
  • Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
  • Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
  • Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
  • Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early-career and internal-promotion paths as real options.
  • Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
  • Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of full life-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G&A or corporate functions.
  • A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
  • Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
  • Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
  • Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
  • Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

Bonus Points

  • Building or scaling G&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
  • Leading a cross-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
  • Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.

 

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes. 

Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. Financial Analyst II

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

As a Financial Analyst II at ICON, you will play a significant role in supporting advanced financial planning, analysis, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Do

Your role will involve delivering finance and financial management work to a high standard, working closely with your team and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities Include

• Conducting detailed financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business unit performance and strategic planning.
• Developing and maintaining complex financial models to evaluate business scenarios and support decision-making processes.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to monitor and report on key financial and operational metrics.
• Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
• Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices in financial analysis and reporting.

Your Profile

You will bring relevant finance and financial management experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.

Required Qualifications And Experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in financial analysis or related roles, with a strong understanding of financial principles and practices.
• Advanced proficiency in financial modeling and analytical tools, such as Excel, with experience in financial software (e.g., SAP, Oracle) being a plus.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders.
• Willingness to travel as required (approximately 5%)

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

• Various annual leave entitlements 
• A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs. 
• Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead. 
• Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being. 
• Life assurance 
• Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others. 

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

The Role: Associate Manager, Startup Accounts Farming 

To sustain and nurture solid relationships with key clients that generate the most income for Razorpay. 

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Building and maintaining relationships with clients and key personnel within their company.
  • Cross-selling and Up-selling to the client base and growing the account to achieve the portfolio quota.
  • Conducting business reviews to ensure clients are satisfied with their products and services.
  • Attending meetings with clients inside and outside their offices to build better relationships with them.
  • Achieving client relationship targets and KPI’s as set by the team lead.
  • Liaising with internal departments to ensure client needs are fulfilled effectively.
  • Escalating and resolving areas of concern as raised by clients.
  • Carrying out client satisfaction surveys and reviews.
  • Monitoring company performance against service level agreements and flagging potential issues.
  • Updating the CRM for any change with regard to a client.

Mandatory Qualifications: 

  • Relevant experience in Key Account Management/Sales in the B2B space.
  • Knowledge of best customer service practices.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build rapport with customers.
  • Go-getter attitude.
  • Hardworking with a strong work ethic.
  • AI Knowledge & AI Tools
